entries.test: Accenture's publicly reported AI investment, attributable business results, and stated targets would show whether its AI bet had paid off by publication.
entries.note: The proposition preserves the tentative assessment of existing results.

entries.test: Accenture's publicly stated expectations for its AI rollout and reported results would show whether the rollout delivered the anticipated gains by publication.
entries.note: The rollout assessment is firm and testable. Competition hurting its business is presented only as a possibility.

entries.test: Public technical documentation of Claude Code's architecture and functionality would establish whether it combines neural and symbolic components as a specialized coding system.
entries.note: The parenthetical directly asserts this characterization.

entries.test: Public controlled studies of coding productivity with Claude Code, accounting for subsequent technical debt, would show whether productivity increases when debt does not cancel the gains.
entries.note: This is a firm expectation with an explicit condition and no deadline.

entries.test: Public studies available at publication, including those from MIT, McKinsey, and Bain, would show whether generative AI was delivering large aggregate productivity or business gains.
entries.note: The business and productivity context supplies a plain reading of 'gains.'

entries.test: Accenture's quarterly results and AI investment targets, alongside public evidence of corporate AI returns, would show whether its shortfall reflected a broader pattern already evident at publication.
entries.note: The normalization preserves 'seems' as 'appears' rather than asserting certainty.

entries.test: Public evidence of companies adopting or abandoning practices that reward maximizing AI token consumption would show whether tokenmaxxing was declining at publication.
entries.note: The plain reading concerns declining adoption of a practice, rather than declining total token consumption.
'The whole jig' does not clearly specify the entire generative AI boom. Neither the required disappointment nor the predicted endpoint has a shared, determinate reading.
